currentFormal.sizing: selected allocation is approximately priorityScore-proportional, so RR also affects sizing through the 14% component.

structuralFindings: RR acts at three layers: eligibility gate, additive PriorityScore component, and raw tie-break after rounded post-consensus PriorityScore.
Within eligible range RR 2 to 5 contributes 5.6 to 14 PriorityScore points; the additive contribution saturates at RR=5.
Raw rewardPerRisk continues to differentiate candidates above RR=5 when PriorityScore ties, so RR influence does not fully saturate at 5.
Because PriorityScore is rounded to 0.1, raw RR tie-break can materially decide near-equal composite candidates.
A and B construct entry/stop differently, so RR distribution/comparability must be checked by channel rather than assumed identical.
A high modeled RR can arise from distant discrete resistance/target geometry; it is not itself proof that the target is likely to be reached.
prospectiveTests: RR distribution by channel, price pool, sector and scanDate.
Within-date monotonicity of RR vs D1/D3/D5/D10, MFE, MAE, stop-first and target-first.
Separate RR bands 2-3, 3-5, >5 without tuning boundaries beyond existing formula breakpoints.
Compare current triple-layer RR ordering against a research comparator that removes only the raw RR tie-break while keeping the existing score unchanged; do not deploy.
Measure how often raw RR actually resolves a rounded PriorityScore tie.
Measure selection changes attributable to RR component versus raw tie-break separately.
Channel-stratified calibration because A/B stop and entry construction differ.
Target-reach calibration: expected reward distance versus realized MFE before stop/time horizon.
falsification: If higher RR predicts larger theoretical targets but not better target-first/MFE or produces worse MAE/stop-first, reject monotonic RR quality interpretation.
If the raw RR tie-break almost never resolves actual ties, classify duplicate influence as structurally real but practically immaterial.
If RR>5 adds no outcome value, do not extend additive score beyond current saturation merely because raw RR is larger.
If channel controls absorb RR effects, classify cross-channel RR comparison as channel-confounded.
No RR threshold/weight/target formula tuning before clean prospective evidence.
